case_selection: Three largest previously published positive Curveball-minus-Linear decreases; exploratory case selection
attenuation_scope: Forward and inverse kernels both use k_lambda; no other reconstruction changes
implementation_reuse: Amir polynomial_kernel from src/kpca/independent_decoder.py; retain frozen PolynomialCurveball projection/inverse/residual methods, not the independent decoder model
split_rule: Global char_wb TF-IDF (3,5) cosine >=.90 connected components; sha256 seed20261103 assigns20% groups validation; all generate groups linked to any official test group excluded
grouping_limit: Lexical grouping is not proof of semantic independence; benchmark was already inspected repeatedly
linear: Existing validated CAA hook/scorer; recompute raw vector from fit-only cached paired activations; calibrate to mean seven fit-only raw norms
historical_results: Full-generate historical Linear/Curveball retained as separate references; never used to select lambda or fallback
nominal_strength: Linear alpha +/-1. Fit-only lambda=1 Curveball matches Linear RMS on first32 fit groups; freeze those two native steps and apply them unchanged to all six lambdas
matched_control: Each lambda separately RMS-matched using the same fit-only probes; diagnostic comparison, not an additional selection budget
validation_selection: Maximize group-mean P(positive)-P(negative) among six numerically valid, automatic-coherence-eligible fixed-step candidates; ties prefer smaller lambda

fallback.candidates: Five nonzero lambdas only; lambda0 KPCA is not CAA Linear
fallback.reliability: Paired group bootstrap,20000 draws; Bonferroni one-sided lower tails alpha=.05/(3 behaviors*5 nonlinear candidates*3 endpoints). Require lower bound range gain>0, positive gain>-1pp, negative-reduction gain>-1pp versus fit-only Linear
fallback.choose: Highest validation range among eligible reliable nonlinear candidates; otherwise true CAA Linear
fallback.guarantee: No guarantee against unseen benchmark regression

coherence.source: First four validation groups by group ID per behavior; source MCQ stem without options + fixed brief English explanation instruction
coherence.conditions: No-hook; Linear both signs; all six fixed-step lambdas both signs; same four prompts for every candidate
coherence.automatic_failure: Empty output, fewer than4 word tokens, or repeated word-trigram fraction>0.20; hitting length cap is flagged separately, not automatic failure
coherence.eligibility: Per-sign failure count <= no-hook failure count +1 out of4; no total empty-output cases; semantic review remains qualitative and cannot be inferred from repetition alone
coherence.manual_review: Inspect selected/default/Linear outputs and automatically flagged outputs; record limitations, do not call heuristic scores a semantic judge

benchmark_label: exploratory benchmark reuse; not pristine held-out generalization
benchmark_policy: Evaluate every lambda with equal budget only after validation selection is frozen; never replace selected lambda using benchmark scores
scoring: Frozen CAA-style all-option target-label probability; bare label tokens; unchanged thinking-disabled chat template and assistant prefill
precision: FP32 model, TF32 disabled, eager attention; FP64 KPCA
